ja: 「30MM 1/144 eEXM-17FA フルアーマーアルト」に付属した武装や装甲が汎用性の高いグレーベースのカラーリングで、オプションパーツセットとなって登場！
• 別売りの「アルト」はもちろん、様々なシリーズ機体を強化可能。同月発売の「イグライト 01」もパーツを取り付けることですぐにフルアーマー調にできる。
• 機体のカスタマイズ性を引き上げる中間アーマーと大型武装が付属。
• 別売りの「アルト」以外の機体にも取り付け可能。思いのままに機体をボリュームアップ。
• 付属パーツは様々な箇所に取り付けが可能。シリーズ機体やエグザビークルと組み合わせて、カスタマイズを楽しめる。
en: The weapons and armor included with "30MM 1/144 eEXM-17FA Full Armor Alto" are now available as an optional parts set in a highly versatile gray-based coloring!
• Not only the "Alto" sold separately, but also various series aircraft can be strengthened. "Iglite 01" from the same release can also be made into a full armor style by attaching parts.
• Comes with intermediate armor and large weapons that increase the customizability of the aircraft.
• Can be installed on aircraft other than the "Alto" sold separately. Volume up the aircraft as you wish.
• Attached parts can be installed in various locations. You can enjoy customization by combining it with series aircraft and EXA vehicles.
